description: Step 2: sends the request signed by the agent's own wallet to a Recta route and returns its HTTP status and JSON body. POST /v1/golden-corridor/commercial-evaluations returns, free, a decision (whether a cheaper route than the one the agent would use anyway is proven, and the saving) or an abstention; GET /v1/golden-corridor/commercial-evaluations/{result_id}/execution-artifact then asks for the fee ceiling's signature and, once it is signed, returns the route's transactions. Executing a decision's route creates a fee of 5 % of the verified saving, capped by the permit the agent signs; no saving, no fee.
name: recta_send_signed_request
title: Send a signed request to Recta
